Subject: Proposed contract redlines and pricing ask

Karthik,

Thanks again for the productive pilot debrief last week — team is excited to move forward. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed the latest agreement and have a few non-standard asks before Finance will sign: 

- Liability cap: request to raise to $5,000,000 (we retain risk posture for PHI and critical uptime)
- Indemnity: expand to include third-party IP claims and IPO-era carvebacks (our GC drafted language and attached)
- Warranty: add a 90-day remedies window and a specific SLA credit schedule in Exhibit B
- Commercial: requesting a 20% first-year usage discount tied to a 24-month commit

I attached SunsetBridge_Redlines_20280414.pdf with our redline. Can you confirm if Redwood can accept any of these or if exec approval is required? If so, please let us know the escalation path and timeline — we need signoff by end of month to align with our procurement calendar.

Best,
Elaine Park
VP of Product & Partnerships
Sunset Bridge Health

Attachment: SunsetBridge_Redlines_20280414.pdf (redline PDF — summary shows liability cap and indemnity expansions)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Apr 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed contract redlines and pricing ask — need exec path

Karthik — thanks for flagging. Quick thoughts:

1) Liability cap: $5M is above our standard high-risk threshold. For accounts of this ARR I would expect a counter around $1M — we can consider raising to $2M if there are strong business reasons (HIPAA exposure? integration scope?). Please ask them to quantify expected MRR and PHI exposure in writing.

2) Indemnity: we cannot accept broad third-party IP indemnities without reciprocal protections and some limitations (timeboxed, excluding pre-existing IP, cap tied to contract value). Legal (Laura) will propose redline language.

3) Discount: 20% first-year for a 24-month commit is reasonable to consider — but that likely needs Deal Desk approval and depending on the net ARR impact, CFO/CRO sign-off (pricing decks). Put the proposed discount as a conditional offer dependent on modified legal terms and customer reference commitment.

If Legal cannot reach an agreement with simple concessions, we should escalate to VP Sales + CFO for any deviation from standard liability and indemnity. I can be on the escalation thread.

Marissa
Sr. Director, Sales — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed contract redlines and pricing ask — need exec path

Karthik / Marissa — reviewed their redline (see notes in attached PDF). Summary of legal position and proposed fallbacks: 

- Liability cap: we should offer $1,000,000 total liability cap with carveouts for breach of confidentiality and willful misconduct; for PHI-specific incidents, propose a separate sub-limit of $2,000,000. We will not accept an uncapped liability or $5M flat cap for this tier.
- Indemnity: counter with a mutual IP indemnity limited to claims arising from the other party's breach and exclude indirect/consequential damages. Add a 12-month time limit for bringing claims.
- Warranty: accept a 90-day remedies window but limit SLA credits to a capped percentage of monthly fees; define uptime measurement in Exhibit B.
- Pricing: legal does not sign pricing but can condition acceptance on the 20% discount being limited to the first 12 months and tied to a minimum committed spend.

Exec sign-off required? If Sunset Bridge insists on $5M cap or unlimited IP indemnity, we will need signoff from CEO + CFO (material deviation to risk tolerance). If they accept the legal counters above, Deal Desk can approve the discount and Sales can close.

I've attached a redline with tracked changes and a short approval stub you can use to gather signatures if escalation is necessary (approval_email_stub.txt).

—Laura
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Laura_Redline_20280416.pdf; approval_email_stub.txt

Elaine — thanks for the patience and for sending over the redlines. We had Legal and Sales review and here is our proposed path to get to an executable agreement quickly: 

1) Legal counters (high level): $1M general liability cap; sub-limit $2M for PHI-related incidents; mutual IP indemnity limited to claims caused by the other party's breach; 12-month claim window; 90-day warranty remedies with capped SLA credits. (Laura attached a redline and a short approval stub to facilitate signatures).
2) Commercials: we can offer a 20% discount in year one if Sunset Bridge commits to a 24-month term and a minimum monthly commit (TBD — I propose $60k/month). The discount will be conditional on acceptance of the legal counters above.

If Sunset Bridge cannot accept the counters and pushes for the $5M cap or unlimited IP indemnity, we will need executive approval from our CEO + CFO to proceed. If that becomes necessary, Laura has prepared an approval template to expedite sign-off.

Please confirm whether you can accept the legal counters and the conditional discount by EOD Friday (4/20). If helpful, I'm happy to set up a short call with Laura and Marissa to walk through the changes.

Best,
